input.quote: TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 gives Client an unconditional right to terminate on notice, effective at the end of the following month (roughly 30–60 days), with no early-termination fee, and TrueLink has no convenience exit (its termination rights in Section 13 are breach-triggered). This meets or betters our preferred position; we note only that there is no express pro-rata refund mechanic, though fees are invoiced monthly in arrears.

input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Renewals are 12 months with a mutual 30-day non-renewal window, which meets our preferred position; Client can in any event exit under Section 14 at any time. We note two minor points not worth redlining: there is no Vendor renewal reminder and no cap on renewal price increases beyond the first-year freeze and the MFN in Section 6 (the cross-reference to "Section 12" in Section 13 should read Section 14).

input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: California law with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in California sits at our accepted fallback (California law and courts), and there is no arbitration. We note only that venue is San Luis Obispo County, TrueLink's home county rather than our preferred forum — acceptable, so no redline.

input.quote: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is mutual and allows affiliate transfers, but it has no M&A/successor carve-out and no reasonableness standard on consent, so TrueLink could block a transfer on our merger or sale of assets — short of the fallback. We added a successor carve-out on notice, a "not unreasonably withheld" standard, and confirmation that a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right.
